steps.content: [Black Screen]

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hey, wakey-wakey, little rat. Rise and shine.
[Scene Transition, Back to the Cell]
Blue light flickers. Some pressure digs into her forehead as her senses claw back.
Hella's vision gradually focuses on the figure before her. Malicious eyes, that mocking smile—this is—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Synex?! Ugh—
She jerks back, but Synex matches her movement, relentless, pressing the Hypercube against Hella's forehead.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Awake now? Still breathing? Can you get up on your feet?
Behind Synex, the alchemic beasts twist and coil, no longer attacking Hella. Now, they slither close to Synex, almost adoringly obedient.
(Flashback: Small CG - Alchemic Beast)

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I saw everything. What they did to you in the lab. Fraser rounding up refugees for experiments... You're just like them. That's why you call them your "brothers and sisters"...
Her emotions stirred by the illusion cling like smoke. Hella lifts her head—Synex's smile cuts through her, radiant and razor-sharp.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Aww, feeling sorry for little old me? Look at you, all worked up, your cute little face red as a cherry.
Her fingers brush her cheeks, only to find them wet. Two silent streams, cold against her skin.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: You were crying in your sleep just now, even said my name. Look at you, eyes all puffy. You missed me that much? Or...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Oh, I get it now. You've actually been secretly in love with me this whole time—

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: WHAT?! SHUT UP! SHUT UP SHUT UP SHUT UP!!!
Flushed with embarrassment and rage, Hella hurls the Hypercube at Synex's smirking face, only for it to be caught midair effortlessly.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You jerk! And I actually felt bad for you?! What a waste!
Her eyes, barely dry, well up again. Hella turns her head sharply away, stalks to the farthest corner from Synex, and drops down. She scrubs at her face with her sleeve—hard.
Tap tap. Something prods her shoulder. She stiffens, jaw locked, refusing to turn.
That thing continues to poke Hella's shoulder, unrelenting.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Little Hella? Little rat? Pretty cutie pie Hella— My brave little Hella who didn't even whimper when she fell on her butt—
Hella whirls, fury blazing in her glare, only to find Synex poking her with the tip of her tail.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Still mad?
Smack! Hella swats away the annoying tail, her teeth clenched in fury.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Spit it out. Exactly how are you sabotaging the Black Ring ritual? What's your real plan?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm? Black Ring what? Plan who? My, my, such accusations...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Cut the bullshit! You were singing about chaos yesterday while chasing me! Brave enough to drag me into your mess but too chickenshit to own it now?!

As her mind clears, the truth strikes Hella like a blade: Synex planned this from the beginning. She manipulated the Legion, lured them underground, all to sabotage the ritual and spare herself from becoming the Black Ring's sacrifice.
And it worked. Hella, the Legion, even Hypatia—they had all been puppets in the hands of this so-called "hero."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tell me everything now! Hide one more thing and I'm done helping you!
Synex narrows her eyes for a moment before she breaks into laughter.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Fine, you win. No more games.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Rebellion's no tea party, you know. Every good uprising needs its little trials. After all, what we're up against is not just one "enemy."

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Fraser has set up amplification devices around the refugee camp. Pumping Mania radiation straight into the refugees they "rescued." Turns out one Corpseborne isn't enough insurance for those cowards. Now they want spares. A whole camp full of them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What...?! I thought those were Mania-blocking devices!
Synex shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: If they actually gave a damn about people, those city gates would've swung open years ago.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: But don't worry. I didn't drag you into this blind.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The <color=#fb9259>maze</color> is not only the institute's little dumping ground for failed alchemic beasts, but also my turf. Dragons hoard treasure in their lairs, so guess what I've buried deep in mine? Something that'll make those Fraser bastards wish they'd stayed in their ivory towers.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: When their Black Ring plan kicks off and every last eyeball's glued to me, that's your cue to slip behind them and stab where it really stings. Sound like fun?
Hella doesn't answer. Her gaze stays fixed on the ground as she poses another question.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Why me?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't play dumb with me. You've got plenty of other people you could ask. Horo or Hypatia could do this way better than me, but here you are, picking me. Why?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hmm... Because it's fun?
As Hella's fury threatens to erupt again, Synex laughs heartily and clamps a hand atop her head, shoving her down with playful force.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hahaha! Okay, okay, I'll stop messing with you now. For real this time.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The famous DisCity Legion Commander is willing to be your friend, and even the notoriously reserved Lady Campbell opens up to you. That's not something just anyone can accomplish.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Sure, you hit like a wet noodle, but you keep hitting. Cornered? You bite. Outmatched? You outthink. You always find a way to fight back, and you can even come up with solutions that wouldn't even cross my mind.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Every scheme's got cracks, but you? You're the grenade nobody sees coming.
Her fingers slowly trace across the weathered wall, Aurum Secretum radiating from her fingertips, whispering memories long buried.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: And there's one last point...

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: No matter where they are, rats always find a way to survive. No masters, no chains—just pure, stubborn aliveness. They're free, and I like that about them.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Aren't you worried I'll just bail out?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Hah! If you were gonna run, you'd have bolted back in Furor. No point waiting until now.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Tch, the nerve of you.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Fine, count me in! But you have to let Horo and the others go!

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Relax, that little wolf's not half as fun as you. They're just taking a scenic detour. Should stumble on the exit any minute now.
With their negotiation complete, Hella pushes away Synex's hand and dusts herself off as she stands up.
What next? Fight their way out? Hella opens her mouth to voice the question when the ground shudders violently beneath them.
The alchemic beasts grow restless. Synex's wrists jerk as the Aurum Secretum shackles tighten—her smirk vanishes, replaced by something dark.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Tch, these old bastards... They moved up the test explosion.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Sorry, sweetie, looks like I won't have time to escort you out anymore. Be a good girl and find your own way out, okay?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Test explosion? What does that mean? What are they planning to do now?

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Just another simulation experiment those Fraser bastards love so much. Won't kill me, but it'll be a living hell to deal with.
Synex rises and strides toward the door, her voice still laced with amusement—though the warmth has vanished.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: Go find help. Legion or any DisCity friends you know will do, but you need to make it fast.

steps.speaker: Synex
steps.content: The Cocoon will mature soon. Next time... it may not be just a drill anymore.
Without another word, she turns and walks away, her back straight. The alchemic beasts flank her, their presence a silent escort.
Hella stands frozen, her fists clenched, hands still trembling.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Damn it... that just makes me even more worried...!
Gritting her teeth, she slaps her cheeks hard. The sting sharpens her resolve. When she lifts her head again, her gaze is steel.
Then she runs, sprinting off in the direction Synex disappeared.
